item.title: News briefs
item.description: Editor’s note: Organizations in The Register-Herald’s coverage area are encouraged to submit scheduled events and news for the weekly News Briefs. Items can be emailed to emowen@aimmediamidwest.com. Deadline for inclusion in the Wednesday edition is 5 p.m. the Friday prior; deadline for inclusion in the Saturday edition is 5 p.m. the Wednesday prior. Items are published as space allows until the date of events has passed, or for ongoing listings, until removal is requested. The post News briefs

item.title: Thunderbolts rout Sidney 78-42
item.description: SIDNEY — In a game featuring 16 field goals from beyond the arc Tuesday night, Northmont rolled to a 78-42 non-conference victory over Sidney. The post Thunderbolts rout Sidney 78-42 appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Snow Emergency canceled in Montgomery County
item.description: DAYTON — Montgomery County Sheriff Rob Streck has canceled a Snow Emergency, effective February 6, at 1 p.m. for all of Montgomery County. A Level 1 Snow Emergency had been put into effect at 10 a.m. but is now lifted. The post Snow Emergency canceled in Montgomery County appeared first on The Register Herald.
